name: Dranik Hollows: East
summary: A collapsed Dragorn mining tunnel overtaken by Muramite patrols and Discord ruptures.
description: Hollows East is the most structurally unstable section of the Dranik Hollows. Once a Dragorn mining tunnel, the eastern caverns collapsed during the Muramite invasion. Discord energy seeped into the broken stone, creating unstable fissures and arcane anomalies. Muramite patrols use the area as a forward scouting route, while Dragorn resistance fighters hide in narrow alcoves. The terrain is jagged, hazardous, and constantly shifting under Discord pressure.
